description: Seen building fz-sc8.62: 'def _ + _, do: arithmetic_error()' does not parse as a definition head, while 'def _left + _right, do: ...' does. Elixir accepts both (a bare _ is a valid parameter pattern). Fix in the parser's def-head reading so an operator head with _ operands is a definition, with a parser test and a fixture on all three paths.
title: A def head whose operands are both underscores parses
